mapper.select: SELECT h.help_doc_id, h.title, h.help_doc_catalog_id, c.name AS help_doc_catalog_name, h.author, h.sort, h.page_view_count, h.user_view_count, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM t_help_doc h LEFT JOIN t_help_doc_catalog c ON h.help_doc_catalog_id = c.help_doc_catalog_id ORDER BY h.sort ASC, h.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_help_doc ORDER BY sort ASC, create_time DESC

SELECT h.help_doc_id, h.title, h.help_doc_catalog_id, c.name AS help_doc_catalog_name, h.author, h.sort, h.page_view_count, h.user_view_count, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM t_help_doc h LEFT JOIN t_help_doc_catalog c ON h.help_doc_catalog_id = c.help_doc_catalog_id
AND INSTR(h.title, #{query.title})
AND h.help_doc_catalog_id = #{query.helpDocCatalogId}
AND INSTR(h.author, #{query.author})
ORDER BY h.sort ASC, h.create_time DESC

SELECT h.help_doc_id, h.title, h.help_doc_catalog_id, c.name AS help_doc_catalog_name, h.author, h.sort, h.page_view_count, h.user_view_count, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM t_help_doc h LEFT JOIN t_help_doc_catalog c ON h.help_doc_catalog_id = c.help_doc_catalog_id WHERE h.help_doc_catalog_id = #{helpDocCatalogId} ORDER BY h.sort ASC, h.create_time DESC

SELECT h.help_doc_id, h.title, h.help_doc_catalog_id, c.name AS help_doc_catalog_name, h.author, h.sort, h.page_view_count, h.user_view_count, h.create_time, h.update_time FROM t_help_doc_relation r LEFT JOIN t_help_doc h ON h.help_doc_id = r.help_doc_id LEFT JOIN t_help_doc_catalog c ON h.help_doc_catalog_id = c.help_doc_catalog_id WHERE r.relation_id = #{relationId} ORDER BY h.sort ASC, h.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_help_doc_view_record (help_doc_id, user_id, user_name, first_ip, first_user_agent, page_view_count, create_time) VALUES (#{helpDocId}, #{userId}, #{userName}, #{ip}, #{userAgent}, #{viewCount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_help_doc_view_record SET last_ip = #{ip}, last_user_agent = #{userAgent}, page_view_count = page_view_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE help_doc_id = #{helpDocId} AND user_id = #{userId}
